description_en: Retrieves a temporary download URL for the HTML result report of an AI Red Teaming scan task. The URL is valid for 2 hours. An empty string is returned if the report has not been generated
description_zh: AI Red Teaming 获取扫描任务 HTML 结果报告的临时下载链接，链接有效期 2 小时，报告未生成时返回空字符串
name: GetScannerTaskResultHtmlUrl

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan task. This is the TaskId returned by CreateTargetScanTask or the ScannerTaskId returned by ListScanTasksByTarget. If the task does not exist or belongs to another tenant, a 400 error is returned to avoid exposing whether the resource exists
parameters.help_zh: 扫描任务的唯一标识（CreateTargetScanTask 返回的 TaskId，或 ListScanTasksByTarget 返回的 ScannerTaskId）；任务不存在或归属其他租户时统一返回 400，不暴露资源是否存在
parameters.name: scanner_task_id

Data.description_en: The query result, which contains the temporary download URL for the HTML result report
Data.description_zh: 查询结果，包含 HTML 结果报告的临时下载链接

ScannerTaskResultHtmlDownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL for the HTML result report. The URL is valid for 2 hours. After the URL expires, call this operation again to obtain a new URL. If the report has not been generated, this value is an empty string. The actual value is a signed temporary URL from object storage that includes signature parameters
ScannerTaskResultHtmlDownloadUrl.description_zh: HTML 结果报告的临时下载链接，有效期 2 小时，过期需重新调用本接口获取；报告尚未生成时为空字符串。实际值为对象存储签名临时链接（含签名参数）

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
